method: Real Chromium viewport captures at device scale 1. Original application appearance preserved; no invented UI or mock API responses. Screenshots remain in the source interface language.

rano.state: Public storefront home; no checkout or payment performed.
rano.limitations: Original transparent heading-span defect preserved. Original mobile page overflows to a 436px layout viewport; capture uses the requested 390px device viewport. Website business metrics are source-page claims, not independently verified outcomes.

tenge.state: Original built-in seedDemo data loaded through the app UI into isolated localStorage: seven sample transactions, two goals and one deposit. Google Apps Script domains blocked before navigation; no private finances or cloud synchronization.
tenge.galleryTreatment: Top-aligned 5:4 crop of the mobile screenshot. Both original viewport captures remain available in the viewer.

jan-plov.state: Public home hero with original site photography and branding; no inquiry or WhatsApp message sent.
jan-plov.limitations: Original mobile CSS hides the hero photograph; preserved without retouching. Business claims and image authorship were not independently verified.

bulbul.state: Real local FastAPI/SQLite backend and original frontend. Anonymous feed with three source-provided sample posts and sample counters; not evidence of live community adoption. No authentication, real accounts, private messages or remote API access.
bulbul.localConfiguration: Temporary API origin redirected to localhost; signing secret and seed password randomized; disposable database. Temporary sources, dependencies and services removed after capture.
bulbul.limitations: Original mobile header overflow/clipped registration control preserved. Source service worker has unresolved conflict markers; normal feed rendered without changing it.

calories.state: Real local FastAPI/SQLite app with a fresh disposable database. Three fictitious entries marked пример added through the actual localhost API: oatmeal 340, apple 95, yogurt 120; total 555. Original daily goal 2000. Not personal health records.
calories.attribution: Original interface credits Жанибек, Данчо and Димаш. Sole authorship is not claimed. Team dialog was never opened; portrait assets and repository database were not downloaded.
calories.limitations: Mobile capture ends at the table total; history is below the viewport. Temporary app, database, dependencies and services removed after capture.
